cvs.text: Full-stack software developer with expertise in SQL, Python, data analytics, testing, and API integration. Experienced in streamlining data workflows by mapping processes, eliminating duplicated records, and auditing shared data inputs to verify no information is missing. Skilled at structuring tasks, documenting field-level update responsibilities, and producing clear procedural documentation to ensure reliable and repeatable operations.

Systems specialist experienced with spreadsheet reports, system maintenance, and operational documentation. Strong track record of monitoring system metrics, comparing performance logs against schedules, and identifying anomalies. Methodical approach to maintaining data integrity through account audits, systematic checks, and writing detailed runbooks to ensure repeatable, reliable procedures.

Quality assurance and testing professional experienced with business tools and automated workflows. Skilled in comparing test results, identifying data discrepancies across systems, and creating clear reports on failed checks. Adept at isolating edge cases, documenting expected outcomes, and maintaining structured checklists to support reliable data tracking and reporting.

Reporting and data specialist experienced in combining multi-source order exports into PostgreSQL databases using mapping tables to standardise identifiers and resolve duplicates. Proficient in writing SQL queries to validate totals against source files and comparing weekly return reports against warehouse data to trace missing or duplicated records. Skilled in designing data models linking customers, orders, and returns, complete with import validation checks to enable repeatable monthly reporting.
